positions.title: Game Design Engineer (Remote)
positions.description:
Technologies: Unity, C#, Photon Unity Networking, Unity WebGL, Unreal Engine, C++, Unreal Blueprints
• Worked within a fully remote team environment using agile methodologies with Jira and Git repositories.
• Interpreted client needs into gameplay systems and solutions.
• Developed vertical slice prototypes for client review and feedback
• Designed levels, environments, player UI/UX, and gameplay mechanics for multiple projects.
• Implemented gameplay mechanics, character abilities, and basic AI functions for multiple projects.
• Wrote clean, performant, bug-free code.
• Implemented industry standard design philosophies and practices.

positions.title: XR Showdown Internship - Programmer
positions.description:
Worked with a team of 7 to develop a prototype of an immersive electrical engineering simulation in VR using Unity3D and C#.
•	Utilized agile development techniques to manage the limited work time of 3 hours per day.
•	Developed application compatibility with the Oculus using VRTK v4.
•	Translated the ideas and expectations of the Project Manager into workable and reasonable solutions for the programming team.
•	Participated in various media presentations to showcase work done on the project.
•	Worked with project mentors to improve skills with Unity and learn best practices for Unity and 
	C# development.
•	Presented a live tech demo broadcast over a range of live streaming services such as Twitch, 	
	YouTube and Facebook.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed an add-on feature for Lockheed Martin's Prepar3D platform using C++ and HTC's Vive Pro Eye head mounted display. 
•	Developed a standalone application that controls features within the add-on using QtCreator.
•	Learned and incorporated the company's best practices into the software development cycle.
•	Perform tests and debugging tasks on a daily basis.
•	Interface software development with project leads using GitLab and SourceTree technologies.

projects.title: We Are Darkness
projects.description:
An asynchronous virtual reality local multiplayer party game in which 1 player in the headset plays as the hero trying to burn down the accursed mansion while the players on PC act as “The Darkness” trying to snuff out their light.

My contribution to the project was designing a procedural generation system for the dungeon itself, providing an effectively infinite number of levels for players to experience, a new level generated each time they start the game

projects.title: Virtual Vanguard's Electrical Engineering Simulation
projects.description:
Worked with a team of 7 to complete a deliverable prototype of a VR simulation meant to train entry level electrical engineers. The goal was to provide an immersive experience to help foster a connection between the user and the basic concepts of electrical engineering. Our prototype simulation focused on several core electrical concepts involving Ohm's Law, circuits in a series, circuits in parallel, and powering LEDs. 

The simulation was built with to be compatible with the Oculus Rift, and runs entirely within VR. It features a Tron-like visual style, audio and visual feedback, as well as some haptic integration.

This project was sponsored and funded in part by ExxonMobil's Immersive Technology Studio.
